featured_reviews.name: Deepika Pote
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when your mind feels trapped in an endless loop of thoughts… when problems don’t just stay outside, they follow you everywhere. That’s exactly where we were... when we decided to try the Kohinoor room at Mystery Room, Andheri West..
and honestly, we didn’t realize then how much we needed it.
From the moment we entered, the energy shifted. The staff welcomed us with such warmth..always smiling, patient, and genuinely excited for us. It didn’t feel like just another activity; it felt like someone quietly telling us, “You’re going to feel better here.”
And then the game began.
What I loved the most was how brilliantly the clues were designed...hilarious, clever, and surprisingly nostalgic.. It was a reminder ...It felt like everything I had ever studied, observed, or casually learned in life was suddenly coming together. Each puzzle wasn’t just a task...it was a spark. A distraction. A reminder that the mind can still play, think, and solve… even when it feels heavy.
There were moments we laughed uncontrollably...cant tell you d exact details , moments we got stuck, and moments where we just looked at each other and said, “Wait… could it be this?” And when things started clicking, it wasn’t just about solving the room...it felt like breaking through something inside us. We dint panic ,got angry, or blamed each other but were focused on problem solving..
And then… that bell rang.
That sound ..it wasn’t just a signal that we had completed the task in hand... It was a jolt.... The exact jolt we didn’t know we needed... For those few minutes, we weren’t thinking about stress, worries, or anything weighing us down. We were just present, quick..and connected... We dint think ... We just did what needed to be done ..and laughed out our hearts....
We walked out lighter. Clearer. Almost reset.
If you’re feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or just mentally exhausted, this place is more than just an escape room. It’s a pause. A shift. A small but powerful break from the chaos inside your head.
For me and my sister, it wasn’t just an experience...it was a moment of healing.
A must-visit. Truly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had.

featured_reviews.name: Akash Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
The ultimate test of wits and teamwork: "The Kon of Kohinoor" at Mystery Rooms Andheri. My team and I took on this "Mission Impossible" with just one hour on the clock, and it was a total blast. The room was packed with intricate puzzles and clever clues that kept us on our toes every single second. It felt like we were in a real-life spy movie, racing against time to steal the diamond.
​What really made the experience stand out was the incredible staff. They were super friendly and right there to help whenever we got stuck, nudging us in the right direction without giving anything away. Their support was crucial and made the whole thing so much more fun.
​If you're looking for an unforgettable adventure that's challenging, exciting, and full of laughs, you have to try this. It's truly a crazy fun experience that I'd recommend to everyone. We're already planning our next mission!!!

featured_reviews.name: Pinkesh Kamwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a great time at Mystery Rooms Andheri. We played two games — Abduction and Night in Bhangarh, and both offered very different but equally exciting experiences.

Abduction was more of a pure mind game, focused on solving puzzles and thinking logically as a team — really engaging and satisfying.

Night in Bhangarh was the highlight for all of us — slightly spooky with dark horror themes, adding an extra thrill. The experience of crawling through spaces, solving clues, and escaping under pressure made it super immersive and fun.

Overall, a perfect mix of challenge, teamwork, and thrill. Great place to visit with friends if you enjoy puzzle-solving and a bit of adventure 👍

featured_reviews.review_text:
My expectations for this trip were honestly quite low, but Adventure Geek completely exceeded them. The entire experience was well organized, enjoyable, and filled with wonderful memories.
One of my biggest concerns before the trip was the washroom facilities, as this was my first adventure trip. However, I was pleasantly surprised to find that the washrooms were very clean, neat, and well maintained throughout the trip.
A special shoutout to Sohil and Vinay, who led our Mumbai bus group. They guided us exceptionally well, were friendly and approachable, and made the entire journey fun and comfortable. Their experience in managing groups was evident, and they ensured that everyone felt included and had a great time.
The games and activities they conducted were incredibly fun and interactive. They helped everyone connect, break the ice, and create amazing friendships. In just a short time, a group of strangers turned into a group of friends, and that's something I'll always cherish.
What started as a trip with low expectations turned into one of the most memorable experiences I've had. Thank you, Adventure Geek, for the amazing organization, wonderful memories, and the incredible people we met along the way. We absolutely loved Adventure Geek and can't wait to join another trip soon! ❤️🏕️✨🌿

featured_reviews.name: Prachi Biyani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to Bhandardara for the fireflies festival not knowing what to expect. I came back with one of the best weekends of my life.

The trip was special not just because of the destination, but because of the people, the group, the conversations, the memories made along the way. That kind of experience doesn't happen by accident.

Our team leaders Sohil sir, Vinay sir, and Ahbas sir made sure no one felt left out, ever. From ice-breaking games on the bus to bonfire stories under the stars, there was never a dull moment. They ran a seamless two days- smooth, organised, and genuinely fun.

The campsite was well-maintained and hygienic, with easy access to washrooms and a restaurant. One tent for two people, comfort was clearly a priority.

The night trek to the fireflies was the highlight for most, and for good reason. Sohil sir made sure everyone reached the peak safely, and when we got there, it felt like a movie. Watching the fireflies glow across the valley, holding one in your hand... that's a once-in-a-lifetime moment. We even got to click pictures with them, thanks to a local who helped us out.

Food was homelike and hearty- roti sabzi and rice for dinner, poha and bread butter for breakfast, and a lunch stop at Shiv Sagar on the road.

But honestly? The return journey might have been the highlight. We played Mafia on the bus back to Mumbai, full bus participation, absolute chaos, core memory unlocked. We also made a reel. Obviously.

If you're looking for a trip that's well-organised AND actually fun, Adventure Geek delivers. Special mention to Vinay sir and Sohil sir, you made this one unforgettable.

highly recommend. 10/10

Right from registration to payment, everything was smooth and hassle-free. Unlike some other organizers who make the process feel complicated and ask endless questions, the entire experience here was simple and welcoming.

A special mention to Vinay and Sohil — their positive attitude and friendly nature make you feel like you are travelling with family. They make sure that no one feels left out and everyone feels comfortable throughout the trip.

The itinerary was very well planned with timely pickup, a super social environment, and most importantly, a heavenly camping location. The arrangements were excellent — clean toilets, delicious food, clean bedsheets, pillows and blankets inside the tents, and even a proper backup shelter in case of rain.

They took care of every little thing, from fun games to making sure everyone was enjoying. Unlike some trips that mostly focus only on young crowds, this one felt truly family-friendly where people of all age groups could enjoy equally.

The firefly experience was absolutely magical. I really appreciated how they explained everything beforehand — how to observe this beautiful natural phenomenon without disturbing or harming the fireflies, while staying in sync with nature.

Overall, everything was amazing. A big thanks to Vinay and Sohil for putting so much effort into creating such a wonderful experience. Also, our group members played a huge role in making the trip memorable because everyone was so caring and friendly. We were lucky in that aspect too!

We are definitely looking forward to joining more monsoon trips with Adventure Geek.

— Madhulika & Chetan

featured_reviews.name: Amit Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Escapeverse and chose the "Murder on Eclipse Express" room. Based on the marketing and hype around their use of advanced technology and sensors, I had high expectations. Unfortunately, the experience did not justify the price we paid.

While the room does use a few sensors and automated mechanisms to unlock doors, the technology itself is quite limited and does not significantly enhance the gameplay. The "latest technology" claim feels exaggerated compared to what is actually offered inside the room.

The biggest disappointment was the storyline. As a murder mystery-themed escape room, I expected a logical and engaging investigation. Instead, many of the conclusions required players to make unrealistic assumptions, and the story progression often felt disconnected from the clues provided. Rather than rewarding logical thinking, several puzzles seemed to rely on guesswork. A good escape room should make players feel like detectives solving a mystery, but that feeling was largely missing here.

The room theme was "Murder on Eclipse Express," yet there was very little that made us feel like we were actually on a train. The ambience, setup, and overall immersion did not effectively support the theme. The train environment felt underdeveloped, which made it harder to connect with the story.

Another point worth mentioning is the room size. The space is quite limited and is best suited for 2–3 participants. Larger groups may find it cramped, with some members having little to do during certain parts of the game.

The overall condition of the premises was also disappointing. If you visit, I would recommend using the lift instead of the stairs, as the staircase were dirty and lighting was not there during our visit. Additionally, there were ants outside the room entrance, and some even got into my shoes, causing discomfort after leaving from venue. Basic cleanliness and hygiene around the venue should be maintained more carefully though inside cleanliness was good.

Finally, I was surprised by the handling of the payment receipt. After making payment, I requested a receipt but was initially told it could not be provided. It was only shared the following day via WhatsApp. A receipt should ideally be issued immediately upon payment.

Overall, I found Escapeverse to be significantly overhyped. The technology, storyline, immersion, venue maintenance, and customer service did not meet expectations for the amount charged. There is definitely room for improvement, particularly in creating a more logical story, enhancing the thematic experience, maintaining better hygiene, and providing a smoother customer experience.

featured_reviews.name: Vaishali Bhayani Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Its' a very thoughtful 6 storeyed museum. Many interesting activities for age groups 5 to adults. Activities are classified in three groups -
1) Ages 2-7
2)Ages 8-10
3) Age 10 & upwards
There is a floor about Automobiles explaining everything about cars, their history, their working mechanism and a simulator
There is a Grow Lab, Think Lab, Discover Lab, Terrace, etc. There is a Café on level 1 and a library on level 6. There is a laser printing lab, where kids can make a card paper chocolate box along with their name imprinted on it.
3 hrs is sufficient for kids aged 7. For older kids, may be 5 hrs would do as they would explore more independently.
There is a Mystery room, Koli Ship, a 8-min movie on Protecting Oceans from Pollution, etc. Overall a good visit, which can be more meaningful if volunteers and staff present there are more interested in explaining to the visitors. The volunteers and staff also need to be well-equipped to respond to questions posed by the visitors - both adults & kids

featured_reviews.name: Sunita Deulkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Muso – Museum of Solutions is a great destination if you're looking for a full day of learning, play, and exploration. It’s very easy to reach — just get down at Lower Parel station, and the museum is within comfortable walking distance.

The overall concept of the museum is impressive. You can purchase a full-day pass, which I highly recommend, as there is a lot to experience across multiple floors. Each floor is thoughtfully designed with different themes and hands-on activities. The Science Lab, Play Lab, and Discover Lab each offer unique, interactive experiences that keep children (and even adults!) fully engaged. The exhibits encourage creativity, problem-solving, and curiosity, making it an ideal place for both fun and learning.

There’s also a cafeteria on the first floor, which is convenient when you want to take a break and grab a quick bite without leaving the premises.

The only area that could be improved is on-ground guidance. With so many activities and floors, having more staff members available to guide visitors, coordinate activities, and offer directions would definitely enhance the overall experience.

Apart from that, Muso is a beautifully designed, modern space that truly inspires imagination. A great place to spend quality time with kids, explore, learn, and enjoy a full day of discovery. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Afreen Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this place recently and the experience was quite disappointing.
First, it is definitely not walking distance in the scorching heat from Lower Parel if you have a 2 PM slot. Even locals around the area hadn’t heard of it, so don’t rely on getting proper directions.

We had picked up some quick bites assuming we could have them in the lobby before starting our slot. To our shock, they didn’t allow my child to eat there and asked her to sit near security to finish her dry snacks — extremely unreasonable. Strangely, when we returned, we saw kids openly eating popcorn in the lobby. The rules felt inconsistent and frankly outrageous.

Coming to the activities — hugely overhyped and absolutely not worth the money. KidZania is 100 times better in comparison. The Water Lab was a complete waste and many of the equipment pieces clearly needed maintenance.

Overall, not worth the hype or the cost. Definitely needs better management, clearer rules, and major improvements.

featured_reviews.name: Satyan Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
A must-visit in Mumbai for curious minds of all ages!
​The Museum of Solutions (MuSo) is an incredible, well-thought-out space where both kids and adults can learn something new. Each floor has a unique, engaging theme:
​VRoom: Fascinating insights into automotive history and modern growth.
​Play Lab: Pure fun! Kids will absolutely love all the hands-on activities here.
​Discover Lab: Great for encouraging curiosity, helping kids explore the "why" behind how things work.
​Make Lab: A fantastic hands-on area showing how things are made. The team here is excellent at explaining concepts, and they run multiple engaging workshops.
​Grow Lab: A lovely terrace space filled with plants and insect habitats, perfect for teaching kids about nature and ecosystems.
​Whether you want to spend a half or full day, this is the perfect spot in Mumbai to learn and explore with your kids. They offer multiple timed slots, making it very convenient to plan your visit. Highly recommended! At the end of the day, kids would be drained out with so much information and new thoughts.

featured_reviews.name: Sana Malik
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated my child’s birthday at Neon Splash, and it was nothing short of spectacular! 🌈✨

From the vibrant colour play to the use of safe, organic, and kid-friendly materials, everything was thoughtfully planned. Managing a group of 30 energetic kids is no easy task, but the team handled it effortlessly with complete professionalism and warmth.

The arrangements were seamless, the food was well-organised, and the staff was incredibly friendly and attentive throughout the event. Every little detail was taken care of, allowing us parents to truly relax and enjoy the celebration.

A special and heartfelt thank you to Bipin for being with us from start to finish, guiding us every step of the way. His support and coordination made the entire experience smooth and stress-free.

Neon Splash truly made my kids’ day and mine too! Highly recommended for anyone looking to host a colourful, safe, and joy-filled celebration for children.

featured_reviews.name: ruchi ajmera
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was my son Medhansh's 10th BIRTHDAY party.... and he had so much fun at the Neon Splash! It was truly a memorable celebration for him. The biggest proof of how amazing the experience was is that so many parents messaged me afterwards saying how much their kids enjoyed it.

The place, the arrangements, and the hospitality were absolutely wonderful. Everything was handled so well and the kids had an incredible time with all the activities.

And the best feedback came from Medhansh himself — he said, “This was the best party ever!”

Thank you for making it such a special and joyful experience for the kids. 🌟🎉
(Thanks Bipin, Anna, Ayesha, Harry, Lakshmi and Kusum)

featured_reviews.name: Saniya Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently celebrated my brother's birthday party at this venue, and I must say it was an outstanding experience! The team was truly amazing—each member displayed a remarkable level of calmness and respect, which was especially impressive given that we were a lively group of boys. Their ability to manage everything seamlessly made it easy to trust them completely. My brother and his friends had an absolute blast, thanks to the fantastic service and delicious food that exceeded our expectations. It felt like we could take a break and leave everything in their capable hands, ensuring the party was unforgettable.

I would also like to extend a heartfelt thank you to Mr. Bipin for being such a great coordinator throughout the event. Additionally, the team ensured that even my 2-year-old niece felt included and cherished during the celebrations, which was a wonderful touch. Overall, it was a memorable day filled with joy and laughter!

featured_reviews.name: Clyde Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a fantastic time at Neon Splash! The puzzles were creative, challenging, and really well thought out. The neon-themed setup created an immersive atmosphere that made the whole experience even more exciting. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and gave just the right amount of guidance when needed.

Whether you’re going with friends, family, or coworkers, it’s a great place to test your teamwork and problem-solving skills while having a lot of fun. Everything was well organized, and the attention to detail in the room design was impressive.

Highly recommend Neon Splash for anyone looking for a unique and memorable escape room adventure. Can’t wait to come back and try another room! 🔐

featured_reviews.name: Ruchii Wahi
featured_reviews.review_text: I celebrated my mom’s 62nd birthday at Neon Splash and it was one of it’s kind , Big shoutout to Operation Manager Bipin who planned few surprises which even I was not aware , absolutely loved it , kudos to the entire team ..

featured_reviews.name: Manisha Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited No Escape and the kids had an absolute blast, especially in the Haunted and RAW Agent rooms! The Haunted room had just the right level of thrill—spooky but still fun for kids—while RAW Agent was exciting and full of action-packed puzzles that kept them engaged throughout.

The cluees were interactive and encouraged teamwork, which the kids really enjoyed. The staff was very supportive and made sure everyone felt comfortable, especially during the Haunted experience.

Overall, a fantastic place for kids’ outings or birthday celebrations. Highly recommended for a fun and slightly adventurous experience!

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Adate
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing experience! We did haunted room and it was just a thrilling and fun experience! The staff is very co-operative and polite! A must if you are looking to do something adventurous!

featured_reviews.name: kali praveen
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Atal Setu is an impressive engineering marvel and a landmark project, offering a smooth and scenic drive with breathtaking views of the sea. It definitely reduces travel time and gives a world-class experience while driving.

However, there are some downsides – the toll charges are quite high, and during peak hours traffic can still build up near the entry and exit points. At night, lighting in some stretches could be better for safety.

Overall, it’s a great addition to infrastructure and a must-drive experience at least once, but there’s room for improvement in terms of cost and supporting facilities. 🚗🌉
